usefulness.rationale: Understanding is high: the dossier firmly establishes who Bong Joon-ho is (b. Sept 14, 1969, Daegu; Yonsei sociology and KAFA background), his filmography (Barking Dogs Never Bite, Memories of Murder, The Host, Mother, Snowpiercer, Okja, Parasite, Mickey 17), his Oscar recognition, family (married Jung Sun-young 1995), and current activities (Marrakech jury president, the animated film 'Ally' targeting 2027, the HBO Parasite series). Conversation readiness is strong: a reader would know his recent projects, his festival role, his stated working style ('I write my own scripts'), and his themes (genre-blending, social critique, dark humor). Remaining questions is middling: the dossier flags contested and stale claims via status fields, but it never explicitly states what it does not know (e.g., no acknowledgment that the 'most expensive Korean film' budget claim or the son's name rest on thin sourcing), and several compound claims are only partially covered by their single citations. Overclaims found are mostly scope inflation and inferences beyond the quoted passage; neither listed unjustified conclusion (sole-writer on Phantom, the brother/SNU professor mix-up) has a matching dossier claim — the Phantom claim in the dossier correctly says 'writing credits', not sole authorship.
